program.name: The Luminous Crescent

buildings.name: The Aurelia Crown
buildings.subtitle: flagship fine-dining landmark
buildings.exteriorSignature: five off-axis champagne-titanium ellipses, gold glass, orbital sculptures, reflecting pools, and a floating roof halo

buildings.name: Tidal Glass
buildings.subtitle: ocean-facing marine dining pavilion
buildings.exteriorSignature: one photovoltaic-glass wave, white marine ribs, algae lantern columns, water channels, and mist-projected media

buildings.name: The Helix Table
buildings.subtitle: experimental gastronomy complex
buildings.exteriorSignature: twisting pearl and iridescent towers, spiral promenade, irregular bridges, hydroponic void, roof fins, and luminous mist ring

buildings.name: Ember & Ice
buildings.subtitle: dual-concept luxury restaurant
buildings.exteriorSignature: fissured copper volcanic wing, crystalline water-glass wing, diamond portal, thermal courtyard rill, and opposed roof crowns

buildings.name: The Orion Room
buildings.subtitle: observatory cocktail bar
buildings.exteriorSignature: star-field obsidian oval in black water, faceted dome, tilted orbital ring, bridge approach, and coordinate fins

buildings.name: Velvet Circuit
buildings.subtitle: cocktail club, jazz venue and salon
buildings.exteriorSignature: burgundy-to-violet mechanical curtain, star canopy, brass guide line, smoked floating balconies, and acoustic garden wall

buildings.name: Pulse Cathedral
buildings.subtitle: primary electronic-music venue
buildings.exteriorSignature: black central nave, programmable waveform glazing, functional buttresses, monumental blue arch, colonnade, and three beacon spires

buildings.name: Halo Nine
buildings.subtitle: elevated skyline club
buildings.exteriorSignature: graphite shaft, rotating electrochromic summit ring, secondary sky halo, nine reflecting pools, and Halo Walk bridge

buildings.name: Eclipse Cabaret
buildings.subtitle: cabaret, dance and theatrical venue
buildings.exteriorSignature: void-black sphere, polished nickel crescent curtain, equatorial light, fan forecourt, holographic moon, and red stair columns

buildings.name: Aurora Grand Cinema
buildings.subtitle: luxury cinema and premiere venue
buildings.exteriorSignature: stepped screening volumes, monumental mirrored arch, aurora fins, shutter canopy, lenticular panels, and event fountain plaza

buildings.name: Horizon Screen Gardens
buildings.subtitle: luxury open-air cinema
buildings.exteriorSignature: retractable screen between black towers, landscaped brass-lit terraces, bubble pods, four projection obelisks, and curved glass entrance pavilion

buildings.name: Meridian Pool Palace
buildings.subtitle: grand covered aquatic terraces
buildings.exteriorSignature: three droplet vaults, titanium ribs, aquatic projection, roof mist oculus, disc bars, water-veiled entrance, and heated promenade

buildings.name: Neon Grotto Aquaclub
buildings.subtitle: covered lagoon and aquatic nightlife
buildings.exteriorSignature: rough black interlocking shells, magenta-cobalt fissures, basin bridge, ringed cliff bars, waterfalls, humid ridges, and luminous ecology loop

buildings.name: The Prismarium
buildings.subtitle: volumetric and holographic theatre
buildings.exteriorSignature: dichroic faceted crystal around an apparently unsupported black cube, optical plaza, four projection pylons, and mirrored roof prisms

buildings.name: Synesthesia Hall
buildings.subtitle: multisensory experimental concert hall
buildings.exteriorSignature: fluid waveform roof, responsive overlapping ceramic-metal panels, confined mist channel, depth-aligned sign, mirrored trough canopy, and vibration benches

buildings.name: Zero-G Ballroom
buildings.subtitle: aerial and orbital performance venue
buildings.exteriorSignature: pearl sphere above a reflecting basin, three slowly rotating titanium rings, coordinate-grid light, four concealed pylons, and twin equatorial bridges

buildings.name: Dream Arcade
buildings.subtitle: neuroadaptive mixed-reality arcade
buildings.exteriorSignature: irregular chrome, violet, pearl, mirror and blue capsules around a digital waterfall, external tubes, portals, pixel sign, and glitch service tower

buildings.name: Probability Palace
buildings.subtitle: luxury strategic gaming venue
buildings.exteriorSignature: improbable sliding black-glass volumes, champagne probability screens, randomized light lines, mirrored entrance matrix, algorithmic jets, and intersecting frame crown

buildings.name: Chrono Carousel
buildings.subtitle: kinetic temporal simulation palace
buildings.exteriorSignature: engraved bronze time tower, three mechanical rings with seed capsules, counter-rotating iris pavilion, concentric time tracks, and clock-like amber sign

buildings.name: The Phantom Menagerie
buildings.subtitle: mixed-reality speculative-life park
buildings.exteriorSignature: low black mirror bar, bioluminescent tears, translucent biome cells, fern wetlands, black-tree holographic emitters, and vegetation-to-digital transition

circulation.haloWalk: three open-air elevated bridge segments linking four skyline landmarks

publicRealm.paving: wet-look black basalt with champagne-metal edge

program.lightingProtocol: integrated structural neon; retractable or restrained daylight media; warm downward-directed residential edge; localized ecological and dark-sky shields
program.acousticProtocol: large clubs on the outer north boundary; acoustic buttresses, landscape buffers, directional lighting, and quiet inner venues protect guest, residential, and ecological neighbors
